meaning: Reviewable input sequences and expected observations, not a language test harness or an executed trace.

common_fixture.execution: Ordinary addressed LMX Message handlers, each finishing its current turn.
common_fixture.ports: Timer, native and lifecycle providers are REQUIRE_IMPLEMENTATION and nonblocking at the owner boundary.
common_fixture.observer: Owner-local events observer preserves observation order without waiting for another owner.
common_fixture.arithmetic: Doubled fixture values are restricted to the small values shown here.
common_fixture.restart: Each owner incarnation has a distinct address identity; callbacks for an older incarnation never route to its replacement.

patterns.name: Request-Response / Ask
boundary_constraints: At next=9223372036854775807 and active=0, start rejects reason=2 before increment or posting.
A replacement owner uses a distinct address identity. A timer/reply addressed to the old instance is not delivered to its replacement even if its counter also starts at zero.
Timeout does not cancel or roll back an effect in the service.

patterns.name: Become / Selective Stash

expected: no second work result while paused

boundary_constraints: Only work occupies the two-slot FIFO; control/query/reply never enter it.
One pump removes at most one work item and never waits for a reply.
The host keeps the owner alive through the explicit stop observation.

patterns.name: Phased Message Lifecycle

expected: drain epoch=1 sent to both current children

boundary_constraints: The graceful fixture starts with two live children and every native flush eventually completes.
Actual stopped means the host completed that child's termination and cleanup, not admission of a close request.
No required reply, query or wait is scheduled after parent close or from poststop.
Hard crash/restart policy remains the separate supervision contract.

patterns.name: External Blocking Adapter

expected: no success result from admission alone
status phase=0,active=1 while native work remains in progress
no result and no state change

boundary_constraints: For native admission=0, active returns to zero and reason=3 is emitted; no job or completion is owed.
At next=9223372036854775807, admission rejects reason=2 before increment.
The native call runs outside the Message owner; its completion is an ordinary later Message after native holds are released.
Closing admission is not proof that the in-flight native effect was cancelled.
